name: Rare UI
summary: Registry of 24 animated React components — sidebars, drawers, an OTP input, a WebGL orb and more — installed with the shadcn CLI.
description: A free, open-source shadcn registry of animated React components built with Tailwind CSS and Motion: springy sidebars, a family drawer, a WebGL fluid orb, gravity letters, an OTP input, code block, contribution heatmap, step player and animated counter. Every component is a single file you own, installable with the shadcn CLI or MCP, with per-component props documented.
contains: 24+ components incl. Folder, Bounce/Hook/Proximity sidebars, Family Drawer, Fluid Orb, Gravity Letters
component groups: new releases, display, AI kit, navigation, inputs, feedback
install with npx shadcn@latest add swamimalode07/rare-ui/<component> or MCP
every component is free to use; full source on GitHub (1.7k stars)
per-component pages list props, dependencies, interaction type and source code
